svg.title: Project: StyleCode (v0.5.0). A local-first visual UI editor where the canvas is the prompt: draw an interface, ask an AI to change part of it, export real HTML/CSS or React. Now also a workspace for software consultants. TypeScript , React , Vite , Playwright. 168 commits.
